svg.title: The fifth interference order lies at an envelope zero
svg.desc: Calculated double-slit intensity is cos squared pi u times sinc squared pi u over five. The single-slit envelope reaches zero at u equals plus or minus five, removing those nominal interference maxima.

g.text: The fifth interference order lies at an envelope zero
Slit width a; center-to-center separation d = 5a
u = d sin θ / λ (interference order)
At u = ±5: a sin θ / λ = ±1, so the diffraction envelope is zero.
